# Resvary

> Resvary is open-source TypeScript infrastructure for prepaid credits and usage billing in AI products. It reserves a maximum cost before work starts, commits the actual charge afterward, releases the remainder, and records an auditable usage receipt.

Resvary is built for technical founders, backend engineers, and platform engineers who bill variable AI usage measured in tokens, seconds, jobs, images, or tool calls. The ledger is payment-rail independent. SQLite supports local and single-node use; PostgreSQL is the multi-process deployment backend.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://www.resvary.xyz/): Product overview, credit lifecycle, live demo, deployment boundaries, pricing status, and FAQ.
- [Pricing](https://www.resvary.xyz/pricing.md): Current open-source cost and managed-service availability.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/horn111/resvary): Apache-2.0 source code, packages, tests, and release history.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/horn111/resvary/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Install the SDK and run the first credit lifecycle.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/horn111/resvary/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Components, storage boundaries, and data flow.

## Core concepts

- [Prepaid credits](https://github.com/horn111/resvary/blob/main/docs/prepaid-credits.md): Posted, reserved, and available balances.
- [Usage rating](https://github.com/horn111/resvary/blob/main/docs/usage-rating.md): Immutable price versions and final charge calculation.
- [Usage receipts](https://github.com/horn111/resvary/blob/main/docs/receipts.md): Operational evidence for committed charges.
- [Production persistence](https://github.com/horn111/resvary/blob/main/docs/production-persistence.md): PostgreSQL deployment and migration guidance.
- [Security model](https://github.com/horn111/resvary/blob/main/docs/credit-security-model.md): Credit invariants, trust boundaries, and failure handling.
- [Operator Console](https://github.com/horn111/resvary/blob/main/docs/operator-console.md): Inspect balances, trace charges, and run guarded recovery actions.

## Important boundaries

- Resvary is not a payment processor, bank, wallet, subscription manager, tax engine, or invoicing system.
- Credits are closed-loop, non-transferable, and non-redeemable.
- The current self-hosted code is free under Apache-2.0. No hosted paid plan or price exists today.
- Arc USDC is a reference external funding path, not a requirement for using the credit ledger.
